title: End-to-end latency atlas: conversation-aware slice maps for streaming vs blocking
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build an interactive 'Latency Atlas' that surfaces per-model + per-route latency distributions (p50/p95/p99) with an explicit split between streaming and blocking I/O modes and conversation-aware cohorts. Unlike existing percentile boards, this view aligns token-level trace segments to user-visible response phases (prefix, streaming-chunks, finalization) and exposes cohort maps keyed by conversation shape, request size, and cache-hit status.

Background: Product and SRE teams need a single exploration surface to correlate tail latency spikes with request shape and streaming heuristics. Current dashboards show percentiles by route or by model but fail to: 1) preserve token-phase context for streaming responses, 2) expose KV cache vs non-cache attributions, and 3) let engineers pivot cohorts by conversation length and sampling of traces.

Scope:
- Data: new telemetry enrichers add fields: conversation_shape (short|med|long|chatty), io_mode (streaming|blocking), kv_cache_hit (true|false), chunk_count, first_token_ms, last_token_ms, and trace_link.
- Dashboards: interactive atlas with 3 coordinated panes: cohort map (heatmap of p95 delta vs baseline), timeline swimlane (aligned streaming chunk boundaries), and percentile sparkline panel (p50/p95/p99 trends).
- UX: server-side sampling + queryable filters for model, route, client_region, and cohort tags.
- Integration: trace hooks link into existing traces (tracing service PR: github.com/redwood-inference/tracing/pull/276).

Acceptance criteria:
- P50/P95/P99 displayed per-model+route with explicit streaming vs blocking split and KV cache attribution.
- Timeline swimlane aligns streaming chunk boundaries to latency bursts for a sampled set of traces with links to full trace.
- Dashboard supports cohort grouping by conversation_shape and request_size and can export a CSV of selected cohort latencies.
- End-to-end test that validates field enrichment (conversation_shape, io_mode) for 95% of test traffic in staging.
updates: 2026-03-02: Spike completed on telemetry schema. Implemented conversation_shape heuristic in 'telemetry-enricher' lambda. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/182.

2026-03-04: Design sync with Product and SRE. Decided to show absolute p95 and delta from baseline; baseline = last 7d median. Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Atlas+Spec.
2026-03-06: Prototype swimlane using sampled traces from staging. Found noise from partial streaming traces; introduced chunk_count >= 2 filter to ensure meaningful swimlane alignment.

2026-03-08: Cross-team review with Runtime (kernel selection) and Serving. Runtime flagged potential cost for tracing hooks at p95 collection; agreed to service-side trace sampling of 1% for high-volume routes and 10% for routes with recent degradations (followup: ENG-771790).

2026-03-09: Implemented schema migration for metrics pipeline (added io_mode and kv_cache_hit tags). Telemetry ingestion job updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-processor/commit/4b7d2e.

2026-03-11: Dashboard scaffolding deployed to staging. Minor UI feedback: need clearer legend for streaming chunk boundaries and explicit label for 'finalization' phase. Added task to refine interactivity (see subtask ENG-771235).
